summary: First-finish smoke testing of hiqanalytix marketing site. Backend (health, POST/GET /api/contact, 422 validation) and frontend (Hero, Services, Industries, nav scroll, contact form validation + successful E2E submission, mobile menu) all pass. Record submitted via UI verified retrievable via GET /api/contact in descending order.
passed: POST /api/contact valid payload → 201 with id + created_at
POST /api/contact invalid payload → 422 with detailed field errors (name<2, invalid email, phone too short, company<2, message<10)
GET /api/contact → 200 list ordered desc by created_at
Hero: brand 'hiqanalytix', slogan 'Your trust is our responsibility.', primary+secondary CTAs visible
Services section: 3 cards (Power Platform, Power BI, Automations)
Industries section: 5 cards (Financial, Automotive, Engineering, Energy, Health)
Navbar link Contact smooth-scrolls to contact form
Empty form submit → 5 inline field errors + error toast
Invalid email format → inline email error
Valid submission → success toast, form cleared, record persisted and retrievable via GET
Mobile menu toggle opens and closes nav-mobile-panel at 390px viewport
